      buy Jeans For Men

      Revamp Your Denim Game with the Best Men Jeans On Myntra

      Since being discovered in the mid-1800s in Genoa, Italy, jeans have come a long way over the last 150+ years. From an obscure, durable fabric worn solely by daily-wage labourers to becoming a crowd-favourite adored by all, the meteoric rise of the classic pair of jeans over the years has been magical. Although jeans products are available for all demographics of the population, men’s jeans dominate the market with more than a 50% market share.

      Types of Men’s Jeans You Can Buy

      On Myntra - India’s largest fashion store - you can find as many types of men’s jeans online as there are body types and preferences. Let’s take a closer look at what type of denim men’s jeans you can buy.

    • Slim Fit Men jeans

      These are one of the most popular men’s jeans available in the market. They typically feature a similar cut to that of straight-fit men's jeans but they taper from the hip to the ankle to offer a narrow opening and this you can pair with any formal mens shirt. The slim-fit men jeans fit snugly and are generally preferred by those who are on the thinner side for both comfort and style. Pair them with a casual shirt and a sneaker for a dapper look that’s good for the office, dinner, or a casual day out.

    • Ripped Men Jeans

      Also known as distressed jeans, they became popular in the 1970s and 80s when the Rock and Roll era was in full swing. You can find that these jeans can be ripped, frayed, or torn and are available for slim, skinny, tapered or regular fits. You can pair ripped jeans with a t-shirt and any of the men coats in your wardrobe for a cool and comfy outdoor look.

    • Printed Men Jeans

      Printed men’s jeans have emerged as one of the breakout trends in recent years as they allow people to express themselves in a unique style that traditional men’s jeans don’t. The print can be big or small depending on your liking. quote, branding, animal or graphic. If you’re wearing printed men's jeans, pair them with a monotone T-shirt and a jacket to have all the eyes peeled on you wherever you go.

    • Regular Fit Men Jeans

      These types of jeans have a straight fit from the waist to the thigh and tend to have a large leg opening. Usually, regular-fit jeans are preferred by men who are averse to skinny or baggy-fitting types of denim. You can pair regular-fit men’s jeans with a formal shirt, and a pair of casual shoes to complete a look that’s good all year round.
